brief:
A Palestinian man was injured Friday when illegal Israeli settlers attacked families in the Khirbet Allan area of Al-Jiftlik, north of Jericho, IMEMC News reported. The assault occurred in a region where Israeli paramilitary colonizers have carried out repeated incidents against Palestinian communities.

The attack is part of a broader pattern of settler violence across occupied Palestinian territories. Palestinian families in the area face ongoing harassment and attacks from illegal settlement militias operating in the West Bank.

title: Israeli settlers injure Palestinian in West Bank attack
